selectionEntries.name: Updated: October 31st (Chaos Space Marines Slice V1.4.9)
◆ Chaos Lord
👑 Warlord
selectionEntries.comment: Check to designate this Character as the army Warlord; grants exactly one free named trait from the common Chaos Space Marine list. Trait descriptions intentionally omitted.

selectionEntries.name: Chaos Lord (Warp Armour)
selectionEntries.comment: Warp Armour baseline: optional (0/1) Jump Pack +5, Bike +10, or Daemonic Steed +15; existing three mandatory equipment radio groups, three independent optional wargear checkboxes, and one optional Mark of Chaos radio. Lightning Claw +10 is already present in the melee radio.

modifiers.value: This Chaos Lord has a Daemon Weapon without a Mark of Chaos. A Chaos Lord must have a Mark of Chaos to use a Daemon Weapon. Select a Mark of Chaos or replace the Daemon Weapon.

selectionEntries.name: Chaos Lord in Terminator Armour

modifiers.value: This Chaos Lord has a Daemon Weapon without a Mark of Chaos. A Chaos Lord must have a Mark of Chaos to use a Daemon Weapon. Select a Mark of Chaos or replace the Daemon Weapon.

selectionEntries.comment: Terminator Armour body: +10pts; Indomitus/Cataphractii or Tartaros (+2), Terminator melee, Combi-Bolter-based first weapon, common optional wargear and Marks. No Bolt Pistol. Daemon Weapon requires a Mark via selected-safe corrective error.

selectionEntries.name: Chaos Lord with Heavy Weapon
selectionEntries.comment: Heavy weapon body: the chosen heavy weapon replaces both the Boltgun and Chainsword with the heavy weapon and a Close Combat Weapon. No independent Boltgun/ranged or mobility radio. Pistol, optional wargear, and Marks use the same options as Warp Armour.

modifiers.value: true
true

selectionEntries.comment: Chaos Lord initial draft: 80pt HQ, Infantry, exactly five PDF keywords; six mutually exclusive polymorphic MODEL body selections under 🧰 Options. Warp Armour is default. No equipment or weapon packages yet, no additional upgrades/prices on bodies. Uses same Allegiance-dependent keyword metadata and display as Legionaries. No shared Chaos Lord max-one validation added in this revision. | V1.4.3: Warp Armour equipment as specified, sixth Heavy Weapon polymorphic placeholder, shared keyword limit and Mark-required Daemon Weapon corrective warning. | V1.4.6: Terminator Armour configuration populated (+10, armour, melee, ranged, wargear, Marks) with mark-dependent Daemon Weapon error. Other body options unchanged. | V1.4.7: folded formerly separate Jump Pack/Bike/Daemonic Steed blank model variants into one optional radio under Warp Armour; retained existing Lightning Claw +10 unchanged. Terminator and Heavy Weapon models remain separate.

selectionEntries.name: ◆ Legionaries (5 or 10)
5x Additional Legionaries
selectionEntries.comment: Optional full five-model step: Legionary 6 can select a second special/heavy weapon; Legionaries 7-10 have grouped default equipment.

One common-options unit entry: 5 Legionaries (4 Legionaries + Aspiring Champion) for 75 Points, with an optional 5x Additional Legionaries package for +75 Points, bringing the squad to 10. Legionary 5 retains its original special-weapon radio. Legionary 6 in the package adds the second special/heavy-weapon radio (Boltgun default; 15 upgrade choices sorted by cost); Legionaries 7-10 share one default-equipment radio. Preserves original five-model options, keyword profiles, and Allegiance behavior. Special rules are intentionally omitted; PDF remains authority for less common squad sizes.

catalogue.comment: TEST V3. Same faction-local Allegiance forces and optional in-list Allegiance/Rite selectors as V2. Universal HQ/Troops mandatory counters supplied by Game System. Dummy units unchanged. | V3.1 FROM V3: one 0-point Dedicated Transport dummy unit; one three-sentence category-relative corrective error per active force. V4 dynamic category max NOT reused. | V3.2 FROM V3.1: one three-sentence LoW below-2000 real-roster-total error on every Allegiance force entry; no other army rules or unit prices changed. | V3.3 FROM V3.2: eight Crusade Detachment over-limit custom corrective errors in all three Allegiance forces, nine dummy unit prices 0->100; no hard max, no role-exemption system, no other mechanics changed. | CSM SLICE V1 FROM VERIFIED V3.3: independent catalogue ID, name Chaos Space Marines; only TEST Troops replaced with 75-point Legionaries (5) containing the user-specified condensed equipment package. All other dummy units and all configuration/force validation retained. No 10-model variant, keywords, profiles, special rules, or additional Allegiances/Rites encoded yet. | Slice V1.1: Aspiring Champion Chaos Runes, Teleport Homer, Melta Bomb, Auspex Scanner changed from one max-1 radio to four independent optional 0..1 checkboxes. All four upgrade entry IDs, labels, costs, and other catalogue state preserved. | Slice V1.2: Legionaries PDF keyword metadata and player-facing keyword/special rule profile labels added. No equipment/points/force structure changes; game system unchanged. | CSM SLICE V1.3: removed the Let the Galaxy Burn special-rule link and shared profile. Kept only Unit Type (Infantry) and Keywords for Legionaries, with six semantic categories intact; updated shared profile type name to Keywords. No changes to points, equipment, selections, rules, or other unit IDs. | CSM Slice V1.4: force choices are None and Black Legion only; optional in-roster Black Legion selection uses native None and changes Legionaries semantic Legion keyword and emoji keyword profile. Rite remains inert; no mechanics elsewhere changed. | CSM Slice V1.4.1: renamed the Create List no-Allegiance force from Independent Warband to None; its ID and in-roster native (None) remain the same. All mechanics unchanged. | V1.4.2: Replaced 100pt TEST HQ with 80pt real Chaos Lord and five empty polymorphic model choices (Warp Armour default, Terminator Armour, Jump Pack, Bike, Daemonic Steed). Added exact keyword metadata/profile (None and Black Legion). No loadouts or Chaos Lord limit yet. | V1.4.3: Chaos Lord only: 6th polymorphic Heavy Weapon model placeholder; first/default Warp Armour model gets 3 mandatory equipment radios, 3 independent accessory checkboxes, optional Mark of Khorne/Nurgle/Slaanesh/Tzeentch group. Daemon Weapon with no Mark triggers selected-safe local 3-sentence error. Shared Chaos Lord 1-per-army keyword error added on Configuration in both Allegiance forces. No other body variants filled or added restrictions. | V1.4.7: consolidated Chaos Lord Warp Armour mobility; all other units and rules unchanged.
